scope: Eight-record under-detailed mechanics frontier after excluding Batches 396–400

records.name: Fighting Pose I
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super. After the pose animation, the user gains a Basic Movement Speed increase for 20 seconds; current skill-specific documentation identifies the effect as a movement-speed buff rather than a damage or defensive modifier. Exact speed multiplier and frame timing remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose B
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super. The pose grants a temporary Strike-move damage increase for 20 seconds. Current skill-specific documentation confirms the Strike-only scope and duration; exact percentage, stacking behavior, and frame timing remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose D
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Power Up Super. The pose grants a temporary Boost Dash speed increase for 20 seconds. Current skill-specific documentation confirms the Boost Dash-specific scope and duration; exact multiplier and frame timing remain unresolved.

records.name: Android Rush
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super with a four-hit close-range sequence: three kicks followed by a backhand knockback. Directional control changes the final knockback route: neutral sends the opponent forward, up sends them downward, and down sends them upward. Current reference reports about 10% total damage; exact directional launch distances and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Scissors Paper Rock
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super with a stance-based, multi-stage input sequence. After the startup pose, Rock, Scissors, and Paper are selected by their corresponding attack inputs and can be combined for up to three attacks. Rock is a short punch, Scissors blinds the opponent, and Paper is a palm strike that knocks the target away; current documentation describes the three-hit combination as a 3-hit sequence. The move stops the user in place during the selection sequence, so it is not a conventional combo starter.

records.name: Rocket Tackle
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super and charge attack. The user charges forward with the right shoulder for a single hit that knocks the opponent away. When used after a knockback, the chase version teleports the user to the locked-on opponent before the tackle. Current skill-specific documentation reports 10% damage; exact chase timing and frame data remain unresolved.

records.name: Holy Inscription
records.mechanics_notes: Strike Super whose clock-hand blades can be extended through additional inputs for up to four hits, consuming additional Ki; current documentation reports 100 Ki for the first input and up to 300 Ki for the full sequence, with about 15% total damage. Each successful hit builds a Power of Time/Holy Inscription stack that produces a shockwave and powers related Chronoa skills, including Kairos Cannon and Temporal Holy Ray. Current evidence supports up to four hits and the cross-skill empowerment, while exact stack consumption/timing and frame data remain bounded.

records.name: Shining Slash
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super with a sword, single-hit and chargeable. The user jumps forward and slashes the target; holding the input causes the user to teleport directly to the locked-on opponent before the slash. Current documentation reports 10% damage and restricts the CaC version to Human and Saiyan races. Exact charge timing and frame data remain unresolved.

validation.evidence_policy: bounded; no unsupported probabilities, hidden prerequisites, frame data, or patch-independent balance claims
